children: On April 13, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to meet the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). Since then, it converted payables to equity, completed other transactions, and believes it now exceeds the threshold, awaiting Nasdaq's formal confirmation. Nasdaq will continue to monitor compliance and may initiate delisting proceedings if future reports do not evidence compliance.
